description.purpose: Scope marker of the summarizer hive: bundles the prompt-shaping glue and the writer llm behind one entry lane (the collector's close batch) and two exit routes (the system.handover update, or the failure). The session handover step of R-OS-3: a closed generation leaves as one recency-weighted summary, so the next generation does not wake up empty.
description.use_when: One per agent, behind the collector's write route. Instantiate and wire the ports from the parent scope in the same mutation - an island without a crossing edge stays inactive.
description.not_in_scope: No session lifecycle (the keeper closes, the collector batches - this hive only consumes the batch). No memory judgement beyond the summary itself. Where the summary route leads - the agent llm's system.handover, a store, both - is the parent's wiring, not this hive's.
